name: Ultimate Member Widgets for Elementor – WordPress User Directory
author: UserElements

sections.description:
User Directory & Profile Grid for Elementor & Ultimate Member brings advanced user listing functionality to Elementor using data from the Ultimate Member plugin.

Easily create directories, member grids, profile cards, and even real-time filtered lists, all visually with Elementor. Perfect for membership sites, teams, staff pages, and communities.

👁️ View Demo | 🚀 Get Pro

Features

Core Features (Free Version)

  • Display users by role
  • Show any custom user meta field
  • Grid and flip card layouts
  • Responsive on all devices
  • Fast and lightweight

✅ Free Widgets

  • User Directory Grid — Live Demo
  • User Profile Flip Cards — Live Demo
  • Users Meta Fields — Live Demo
  • User Profile Name — Live Demo
  • Users Avatar Display — Live Demo
  • WordPress User Directory Grid

🚀 Go beyond with Premium Widgets

  • 🔥 Sortable & Searchable User Table — Demo
  • 🔥 User Carousel (Swiper Slider) — Demo
  • Filter Buttons by Meta Fields — Demo
  • Zigzag Layout User List — Demo
  • User Search Bar — Demo
  • 2 Column Directories — Demo
  • 3 Column Directories — Demo

Premium Feature Highlights

✅ AJAX Filtering & Live Search
– Filter users instantly by custom fields
– AJAX-powered search and pagination

✅ Sortable User Tables
– Display users in a searchable, paginated table
– Sort by any meta field — name, city, status

✅ Swiper Slider Carousel
– Showcase members in a touch-friendly slider
– Great for testimonials, contributors, or alumni

Highlights:
– Display users by role, custom meta fields, or keywords
– Live AJAX filters and real-time search (Pro)
– Drag-and-drop control of what user data appears and how
– Integrated with Ultimate Member

🆕 New in 2.0: Live Meta Filters with Instant Results
Let your visitors filter members in real-time using custom fields like skills, department, location, or interests — no page reloads. Give users a searchable, modern directory experience.

Use Cases

This plugin is ideal for:

  • Membership directories
  • Online communities or alumni lists
  • Team or staff pages
  • Showcase contributors, volunteers, or experts
  • Private member dashboards or intranet staff lists

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via Plugins > Installed Plugins
  3. Ensure both Ultimate Member and Elementor are active
  4. Find new user-related widgets inside Elementor editor
sections.faq:
Does this work without Ultimate Member?

No. It requires the Ultimate Member plugin to function.

Is Elementor Pro required?

No. It works with the free version of Elementor.

Can I show specific user roles?

Yes. You can filter by role, meta fields, or keywords.

Can I display Ultimate Member custom fields?

Yes. All user meta fields from Ultimate Member are supported.

Can I add search and filters?

Yes. The premium version includes live search and filter widgets.
